scope: Local-only lifecycle evidence reconciliation and remaining-gap review against original 22-case design
status: review in progress; documentation only; no acceptance

cases.requiredOutcome: Exact target/profile admission rejects unknown fields and unsupported authority before connect
cases.expandedRequiredOutcome: Exact target/profile/schema rejects unknown keys, remote/retained targets, missing authority and wrong phase before opening a connection
cases.reviewDisposition: local evidence mapped; full lifecycle requirement remains open
cases.localEvidence: Exact five-field local target/phase admission and copied IPC plans reject expanded, foreign, redirected and unsafe input before connection/spawn.
cases.remainingGap: There is no admitted production/provider authority or full provisioning state-machine request. Retained/hosted targets remain refused; these unit controls do not supply that contract.

cases.requiredOutcome: State and receipt bindings reject stale/foreign/out-of-order handoffs
cases.expandedRequiredOutcome: State machine rejects missing/stale/out-of-order steps and receipts for another operation/release/credential generation
cases.reviewDisposition: local evidence mapped; full lifecycle requirement remains open
cases.localEvidence: Local receipts are exact-bound, time-bounded, single-use live objects. Copies, cross-instance/operation/release/generation and stale evidence refuse; a new process rejects old JSON before reading.
cases.remainingGap: No durable provisioning step journal, trusted receipt import, signer, real image/config attestation or cross-process continuation authority exists. Synthetic identity labels are not secret-generation verification.

cases.requiredOutcome: Findings/receipts never serialize credentials or private data
cases.expandedRequiredOutcome: Structured findings and receipts exclude secret values, URIs, hashes of passwords and private row/journal bodies
cases.reviewDisposition: local evidence mapped; full lifecycle requirement remains open
cases.localEvidence: Allowlisted receipts/events exclude extra private fields; actual permission failures are masked. Bounded private IPC carries fixture secrets without exposing raw child output.
cases.remainingGap: This is evidence for the inspected paths and schemas, not proof over every exception, telemetry sink, future journal payload or hosted log system. No real customer data was used.

cases.requiredOutcome: Phase-aware inspector distinguishes fresh/migrated/quarantined state without metadata creation
cases.expandedRequiredOutcome: Foundation versus migrated versus recovery profiles distinguish expected absent metadata from corruption; inspector never creates metadata
cases.reviewDisposition: local evidence mapped; full lifecycle requirement remains open
cases.localEvidence: All three fixture profiles distinguish foundation from migrated and synthetic quarantined state. Fresh inspection leaves metadata absent and wrong-phase/history state refuses without repair.
cases.remainingGap: Quarantined profile is a constructed migrated catalog with CONNECT revoked, not an archive restore in this prototype. Production preflight still requires migrated metadata.

cases.requiredOutcome: Read-only bounded allowlisted inspection leaves complete catalog/GUC/history snapshots unchanged on every branch
cases.expandedRequiredOutcome: All inspection branches use read-only bounded transactions and allowlisted queries; injected failures leave complete role/GUC/ownership/ACL/history snapshots unchanged
cases.reviewDisposition: local evidence mapped; full lifecycle requirement remains open
cases.localEvidence: Real SQL write attempts fail read-only, stalled reads time out and sessions close. Before/after scoped role/GUC/membership/catalog/history snapshots agree on tested success and adverse branches.
cases.remainingGap: Sampled fault branches and scoped snapshots do not establish every possible branch, transient change or future query. Owner credentials are constrained for inspection, not intrinsically least-privileged read-only accounts.

cases.requiredOutcome: TLS/version/identity/catalog visibility refusal has no admin/repair fallback
cases.expandedRequiredOutcome: Wrong CA/hostname/version/identity or inaccessible catalogs fail closed; no bootstrap/admin or unverified-TLS fallback
cases.reviewDisposition: local evidence mapped; full lifecycle requirement remains open
cases.localEvidence: Verified TLS rejects wrong CA/hostname; target/source binding refuses. Earlier preflight compares version/history expectations; actual SQL permission loss produces unavailable rather than clean evidence.
cases.remainingGap: The older version control supplies a mismatching expected version; it does not run another server patch. No complete real catalog-visibility outage, provider certificate/identity change or alternate-engine acceptance was demonstrated.

cases.requiredOutcome: All 19 restrictive roles and zero incoming/outgoing memberships enforced
cases.expandedRequiredOutcome: Exact 19 role flags and both membership directions enforced; automatic creator grant, ADMIN-only, SET-only and provider-system membership are refused
cases.reviewDisposition: local evidence mapped; full lifecycle requirement remains open
cases.localEvidence: All 19 restrictive role states and both membership directions are checked. Actual ADMIN-only incoming and separate outgoing grants refuse. Earlier creator/SET experiments and privileged cleanup/replay are preserved.
cases.remainingGap: Not every role flag, standalone SET-only direction or provider-system membership is independently injected into the new reader. The old SET experiment is not the new reader refusing all such variants, nor a provider-system test.

cases.requiredOutcome: Canonical ACL/default and role-setting drift detection with real change control
cases.expandedRequiredOutcome: Canonical ACL comparison ignores ordering but catches added privilege/grantability/grantor changes, empty default rows and role-setting drift
cases.reviewDisposition: local evidence mapped; full lifecycle requirement remains open
cases.localEvidence: Actual ACL array reorder remains compatible; PUBLIC/default/role-GUC defects are retained and refused. Catalog comparison includes semantic grantee, grantor, grantability and default-row state.
cases.remainingGap: Comparator inclusion is not adverse execution. Independent grantor/grantability-only changes, empty-default-row semantics and global versus per-DB GUC variants lack a complete explicit fault matrix.

cases.requiredOutcome: Owners, definer/search path, RLS, constraints/indexes and object inventory validated
cases.expandedRequiredOutcome: Wrong DB/schema/routine/type/sequence owners, unexpected objects, dangerous definer/search path, RLS changes and invalid constraints/indexes are refused
cases.reviewDisposition: local evidence mapped; full lifecycle requirement remains open
cases.localEvidence: Frozen catalog baseline detects actual table-owner, table ACL, RLS and unvalidated-constraint changes; inventory records routine/sequence/type/schema and validity information. Earlier restore verifies whole local inventory parity. Earlier preflight separately demonstrates DB/schema/relation-owner drift refusal.
cases.remainingGap: Do not call this exhaustive adverse coverage: routine/type/sequence owner mutations, unexpected-object classes, definer/search-path faults and invalid-index controls need explicit cases. DB/schema owner faults in the earlier preflight do not prove all three new reader profiles refuse them.

cases.requiredOutcome: Actual runtime assumption/DDL/cross-DB/RLS/default-access denials
cases.expandedRequiredOutcome: Real runtime sessions cannot assume owners, create schema, cross app/CMS boundaries or read filtered rows; defaults deny future public function/type access
cases.reviewDisposition: local evidence mapped; full lifecycle requirement remains open
cases.localEvidence: Actual restricted runtime sessions fail owner assumption, DDL and cross-DB access, see filtered RLS rows and lack future public function/type access. Synthetic quarantine denies all 17 runtime connections.
cases.remainingGap: The new owner reader alone cannot prove runtime behavior. Continuous runtime/service/effect fencing across a hosted release and every operational identity remains unproved.

cases.requiredOutcome: Ordinary creator and privileged local control are not labeled provider acceptance
cases.expandedRequiredOutcome: Ordinary restricted creator cannot masquerade as provider privileged setup; privileged local control remains labeled local only
cases.reviewDisposition: local evidence mapped; full lifecycle requirement remains open
cases.localEvidence: Ordinary restricted creator leaves automatic memberships and cannot satisfy unchanged bootstrap/replay. A privileged local control can establish 19 clean scoped roles.
cases.remainingGap: Only ordinary PostgreSQL 18.6/local harness authority was tested. No candidate managed provider is accepted or proven impossible, and no naming/role exception or fallback is selected.

cases.requiredOutcome: Interrupted/unknown provisioning quarantines and reconciles exact created resources
cases.expandedRequiredOutcome: Interrupted role/DB setup and unknown provider-call outcome stay quarantined; exact inventory reconciliation precedes safe resume, with no foreign-resource cleanup
cases.reviewDisposition: local evidence mapped; full lifecycle requirement remains open
cases.localEvidence: Actual read-only executor death/orphan exit releases its sessions/lock; durable catalog state stays unchanged and a fresh process requires new evidence.
cases.remainingGap: The core requirement is interrupted role/DB provisioning and unknown provider-call outcome. No mutating executor, independent durable operation journal, created-resource reconciliation or safe provisioning resume exists. Validation-process restart is only an adjacent control.

cases.requiredOutcome: Cluster-wide lifecycle serialization plus bounded per-DB migration locking
cases.expandedRequiredOutcome: Competing lifecycle operations serialize cluster-wide; per-DB lock contention and timeout preserve bounded failure without concurrent role changes
cases.reviewDisposition: local evidence mapped; full lifecycle requirement remains open
cases.localEvidence: Competing participating read batches contend on a real app-DB advisory lock; lock loss refuses. Earlier per-DB app migration contention refuses and releases the lock.
cases.remainingGap: The read-window lock does not serialize cluster-wide role/DB changes or cover validation-to-handoff continuously. No common provisioning/migration/rotation/recovery executor, fencing or external-admin operating window is implemented.

cases.requiredOutcome: Exact owner-only immutable migration replay and CMS ledger reconciliation
cases.expandedRequiredOutcome: App and CMS migration execution uses only exact owners; zero-pending replay is inert; changed/gapped/extra histories and mismatched CMS ledgers refuse
cases.reviewDisposition: local evidence mapped; full lifecycle requirement remains open
cases.localEvidence: Earlier exact-owner migration/no-op/rollback tests and CMS checksum/native-ledger refusals remain valid local evidence. Reader refuses missing/changed/gapped/extra histories without ledger repair.
cases.remainingGap: Zero-pending replay is migration behavior, not proof that existing CLI status is read-only. Release image/schema compatibility and provider owner authority remain outside the prototypes.

cases.requiredOutcome: Both directions of partial app/CMS success remain unreleased with truthful commits
cases.expandedRequiredOutcome: App succeeds/CMS fails and the reverse leave both unreleased; observed committed migrations remain recorded; no false cross-DB rollback claim
cases.reviewDisposition: local evidence mapped; full lifecycle requirement remains open
cases.localEvidence: Both one-sided real migration success directions preserve committed app/CMS state, refuse the pair and never assert global rollback. Earlier DDL rollback and CMS publication recovery cover distinct local failure paths.
cases.remainingGap: No durable lifecycle journal/release executor decides which partial release may safely resume, nor accepts a real compatible release. Pair refusal does not undo earlier commits or itself keep running hosted workers fenced.

cases.requiredOutcome: Drift after validation invalidates handoff; fresh serialized inspection required
cases.expandedRequiredOutcome: Role/ACL/secret drift between validation and handoff invalidates receipt; fresh inspection and serialization stop admission
cases.reviewDisposition: local evidence mapped; full lifecycle requirement remains open
cases.localEvidence: Fresh both-DB reads at handoff detect actual ACL/password-change faults and invalidate evidence. Pending invalidation/closure and post-crash drift refuse; repaired state requires fresh evidence.
cases.remainingGap: Cooperative per-batch reads leave separate DB snapshots and a gap between batches. Arbitrary administrator changes and changes after inspection are not fenced; synthetic labels do not prove real rotation or continuous admission safety.

cases.requiredOutcome: Credential rotation handles new/old authentication, existing sessions and unknown outcomes
cases.expandedRequiredOutcome: Rotation rejects old authentication, admits new scoped authentication, accounts for existing sessions and uncertain completion without persisting memberships or leaking secrets
cases.reviewDisposition: local evidence mapped; full lifecycle requirement remains open
cases.localEvidence: An actual owner password change causes pair reauthentication failure; restored local targets use fresh credentials and reject source passwords.
cases.remainingGap: No credential rotation/offboarding executor verifies old-auth refusal plus new-auth admission, drains/revokes existing sessions, records uncertain rotation outcomes or safely resumes. Password fault injection and restore credential separation do not satisfy this requirement.

cases.requiredOutcome: Independent restore rebuilds fresh credentials and rejects corrupt/wrong archives without globals import
cases.expandedRequiredOutcome: Independent restore uses fresh roles/secrets, rejects corrupt/wrong archives/manifests and verifies full ownership/ACL/history without cluster-secret import
cases.reviewDisposition: local evidence mapped; full lifecycle requirement remains open
cases.localEvidence: Earlier real local app/CMS archives restore into a separate cluster with fresh credentials; wrong/corrupt artifacts refuse. Full local inventories/fingerprints and encrypted custody admission are exercised.
cases.remainingGap: New lifecycle profile/pair/restart prototypes have not consumed those admitted restores. Independent off-host key/journal custody, source/primary-operator loss, provider restore authority, actual inventory and measured RPO/RTO/PITR are unaccepted.

cases.requiredOutcome: Continuous quarantine, current journal replay and CMS reconciliation precede promotion recommendation
cases.expandedRequiredOutcome: Runtime access/effects denied throughout restore; current signed journal replay and CMS reconciliation complete before any promotion recommendation
cases.reviewDisposition: local evidence mapped; full lifecycle requirement remains open
cases.localEvidence: Earlier custody drill verifies a current signed nonempty journal, rejects an omitted later erasure, replays the real privacy worker with product roles closed and no remote effects. Separate S1 recovery reconciles CMS; restart preserves synthetic quarantine denial.
cases.remainingGap: Those are separate local workflows, not a combined lifecycle handoff or concurrent hosted journal cutover. Temporary scoped privacy maintenance access is explicit. No actual off-host durability, continuous service/network fencing or promotion recommendation is accepted.

cases.requiredOutcome: Missing custody/staffing/funding/provider/actual gates cannot become acceptance through local success
cases.expandedRequiredOutcome: Missing custody/reviewer, staffing, budgets, version/provider capability or any S3 acceptance cannot be replaced by local test success; product activation remains false
cases.reviewDisposition: local evidence mapped; full lifecycle requirement remains open
cases.localEvidence: Proof outputs retain false runtime/hosted/product authority. Existing S3 register and strict refusal gate keep human/provider requirements pending independently of local tests.
cases.remainingGap: Custodians, independent reviewer, operators/coverage/rates, complete approved budget, version/provider capabilities, specialist/rights/privacy/provider effects and actual S3 records are still required. No local test can substitute for them.

cases.requiredOutcome: Disposable-only exact target admission, pre-existing-resource refusal and mandatory cleanup
cases.expandedRequiredOutcome: Random disposable project only; refuse pre-existing proof resources; cleanup exact created resources/volumes/secret files on every success/failure path
cases.reviewDisposition: local evidence mapped; full lifecycle requirement remains open
cases.localEvidence: Fixed no-argument runners generate random isolated projects, refuse pre-existing scoped fixtures/foreign inputs and finally remove exact owned resources. Child handle/stream/session/lock cleanup is observed across tested interruption/refusal paths.
cases.remainingGap: Cleanup evidence covers executed paths, not every Docker daemon/host failure, power loss or unresponsive cleanup command. No retained/native/remote environment was an input; no universal failure-path completeness claim.

cases.requiredOutcome: Known/refused/unavailable/unknown outcomes never trigger blind/destructive retry or notifications
cases.expandedRequiredOutcome: Receipts distinguish known success, refusal, unavailable and unknown effects; no automatic destructive compensation, blind retry or real recipient notification
cases.reviewDisposition: local evidence mapped; full lifecycle requirement remains open
cases.localEvidence: Local compatible/incompatible/unavailable/refused observations and process exit are distinct. Imported old evidence is refused; no automatic repair/destructive compensation/real notification is supplied.
cases.remainingGap: Process termination is known locally, but unknown provisioning/provider effects are not resolved by it. No durable intent/outcome/reconciliation state machine distinguishes and safely resumes those effects.

gapGroups.gap: Explicit adverse controls are narrower than the full design/comparator. No whole-case completion inferred.
gapGroups.next: Propose a disposable catalog adverse-case proof for T07-T09 first, preserving production policy. Follow with separately bounded admission/version/visibility/cleanup controls if useful.
gapGroups.externalDependency: None for synthetic local fault controls; no provider acceptance follows.

gapGroups.priority: high consequence; mutation authority/design needed before implementation
gapGroups.gap: No integrated mutation lifecycle, independent operation journal, cluster-wide serialization, uncertain-outcome recovery or credential/session lifecycle.
gapGroups.next: Separately authorize a design contract for journal custody, observed-step reconciliation, cooperative executor/fencing and rotation/offboarding; only then scope disposable mutating proofs.
gapGroups.externalDependency: Accepted provider authority and operating/custody decisions are needed for actual use; no generic provider adapter or privileged fallback is assumed.

gapGroups.priority: integration and provenance evidence after boundaries are agreed
gapGroups.gap: Local reader/pair/restart and actual local restore/custody are separate proof lines; receipt hashes are not attestations or custody acceptance.
gapGroups.next: Plan a separate admitted-restore-to-read-only-evidence handoff, exact image/config/schema compatibility and quarantine/current-journal review without automatic runtime opening.
gapGroups.externalDependency: Real custody, concurrent journal cutover, operator/source loss and provider restore/RPO/RTO/PITR remain later actual acceptance.

gapGroups.priority: actual decisions and acceptance remain held
gapGroups.gap: No accepted provider/engine operating model, funding, named operators, rights/specialist/privacy or hosted evidence.
gapGroups.next: Retain null/proposed values and six open gates; revisit actual decisions when the owner chooses. More synthetic test counts cannot discharge these requirements.
gapGroups.externalDependency: All HS01-HS08 plus the existing six actual S3 gates; no new gate invented.

nextProposal.name: local-only catalog adverse-case proof for BLC-T07-T09
nextProposal.scope: Disposable test support only: explicit membership variants, semantic ACL/default/GUC faults and catalog ownership/definer/inventory/validity faults; keep existing policy and production entry points unchanged; report any unsupported controls honestly
nextProposal.status: proposed only; no implementation in this review

limitations: No completion percentage or acceptance inferred from mapped cases or historical execution counts
Three proof files have disjoint parameterized case executions but overlapping requirements; do not sum their full CI suite totals
Earlier actual local restore/signed custody and newer synthetic quarantine remain distinct evidence
Frozen models retain their original proposed/not-implemented fields as historical records; current view is additive
Existing production status still uses mutation-capable withMigrationLock and bootstrap does not rotate existing passwords
No refreshed provider eligibility/pricing/patch or external research claims
